change: MIX foreground admission now retains authenticated replay-read evidence, fresh message COMMIT knowledge, returned results and a consuming local wake through the existing frame owner.
behavior: A private invocation binds immutable ingress and the prepared store command. Receiving MIX authority comes from application configuration; equal public IDs cannot pair different invocations.

Existing-message lookup keeps its original ordering before mutable membership. Raw Existing knowledge survives a pending rollback, while only the repository's authenticated classification supplies Replay and its original item ID.
Authenticated replay-read evidence is separate from fresh message COMMIT evidence. Conflict, TooLarge and NotParticipant retain their receipt-free refusal meanings.

Fresh storage retains the actual archive identity and nonempty outbox projection while preserving SQL text, binds, authority checks and ordering. The separately committed capacity-reconciliation prelude remains separate from message admission.

COMMIT entry is recorded only when the real future is polled; successful receipt precedes returned completion. Contradictory returned data remains diagnosable without erasing positive receipt knowledge or granting a wake.

Only a matching nonempty Stored completion grants one consuming synchronous local wake. Empty-audience Stored and Replay grant no wake. Valid Stored retains the audience once; contradictory returns preserve their raw data.

Lazy frame registration skips preparation for legitimate absence and rejects retirement or conflict without compatibility fallback. The existing frame runner drops its child before retiring the MIX owner.

validation.rust_selection: 17 new pure/fake component cases and 14 unchanged affected controls; each inventory-verified full name ran once with --exact.
validation.source_gates: Execution, admission, architecture and outbound XML checks passed.

retained_first_stop.reason: An existing native-MIX ACK negative probe matched both its original COMMIT call and the new foreground call. Its exactly-one setup assertion stopped the batch before Cargo or Rust tests.
retained_first_stop.correction: The probe now matches the original native-ACK call arguments exactly. Its exactly-one assertion and verifier remain intact; no Rust change was needed. The fresh corrected batch passed all 41 commands.

limits: The five new protocol-module tests compose real owners, wrappers and frame helpers with supplied fake read, classification, projection, rollback and wake facts. They do not execute the complete protocol-to-MixService-to-PostgreSQL path.
Actual cryptographic classification, SQL rollback, generated outbox identities and broker publication remain source/gate correspondence claims until real-adapter evidence is collected.
No message COMMIT does not mean no database mutation: the existing capacity-reconciliation prelude is separately committed.
This checkpoint does not accept the MIX outbox worker lifecycle, full auth correlation, saved cross-domain composition or full Stage4.
Historical Stage3 results and retained failures remain bound to their original sources. Live SQL, wire and aggregate resource qualification remain later-stage work.
The earlier TLS response-EOF failure remains RootCauseUnknown; later green CI does not establish its resolution.
detailed_evidence: Exact source snapshots, the original stop, corrected ordinary command records and tested artifacts are retained privately; this public summary omits raw execution metadata.
